newsitem.title: USA: Bentley sees doubling revenues in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Bentley sees doubling revenues in 1998.

text.p: Bentley Pharmaceuticals Inc, reporting a widening loss in the second quarter, said Thursday it expected to double its revenues to $32 million by in 1998.

"The company anticipates that with the successful completion of the first phase of its growth strategy, which will include other product acquisitions in addition to Schwarz Pharma Inc by the end of this year, revenues should double in 1998 and approach $32 million," said chief executive James Murphy in a statement.

The pharmacautical company reported a net loss of $1.1 million, or $0.33 a share, compared with a $700,000 loss, or $0.22 a share in the 1996 quarter. Quarterly sales dropped to $4.3 million from $4.7 million in the 1996 quarter.

Murphy attributed the drop in sales to the company selling its French subsidiary in June. He said Bentley's Spanish subsidiary's sales rose 26 percent, but a strong U.S. dollar reduced the increase to 11 percent in dollar terms.
The company's stock gained 1/16 to 2-15/16 Thursday.
